findings.title: Identical checkout roots can apply the same fix more than once
findings.description: `buildAttributedViews` can produce multiple views with the same root when a worktree has no `worktreePath`. In that case, `samePath` makes the finding eligible in both the owner’s view and the other view. `applyFixPlan` then applies both entries to the same files, potentially duplicating fix-log entries and overstating the number of fixes. Deduplicate by checkout root or ensure each finding is kept in only one view for a shared checkout.

findings.title: Text output can label a deferred finding as fixed
findings.description: The log lookup matches paths by suffix. In multi-worktree fix mode, the merged finding can come from a non-owner checkout while the fix log records the owner’s checkout; matching their shared relative path can print “Fixed” beside a finding whose copy was deferred. Use checkout attribution when matching, or leave per-finding fix status to the routed report.

findings.title: Git probe failures are mislabeled as checkout state
findings.description: These catches treat every `gitExec` failure as evidence of “not a checkout” or “detached HEAD.” A timeout or another operational failure is therefore returned as a misleading deferral reason instead of surfaced as a probe error. Distinguish the expected nonzero exit for each probe from timeouts and other failures.
